content: Enough probing - with four episodes left I should be converting what I know into the best molecule I can. Ligand 2 has QED 0.910 but SA 2.80 and a stereocentre, so ligand 1 is the better starting material despite its lower QED: it already has the anilide and an NH-azine link, and the best SA in the pool. The recipe that produced my leader is acetanilide, para pyridin-2-ylamino, one ortho fluorine, monocyclic azine, no methylation of any NH. Ligand 1 differs from it in three respects and I have exactly three modifications. Step 1 is the azine: atom 6 is the aromatic carbon carrying the arylamine at atom 7 over a non-ring bond, so I replace pyrimidin-2-ylamino with pyridin-2-ylamino, which measured 0.14 against 0.10 and also costs one less nitrogen of polar surface area.
